content: Alvarez treats policy like the algorithms he condemns: pure emotional triggers, zero cost modeling. His ban rhetoric lacks enforcement budgets, lacks fiscal analysis. A man confusing applause with arithmetic cannot audit a crisis. Expunge the volatility.

Maya Lin calls biometric theft a negotiation problem. Wrong. That data is enemy reconnaissance. She reads rooms; I read war plans. Her diplomacy surrendered our children's minds. Retreat her from this stage.
I call it a hostile takeover of your kids' attention. He's got no exit strategy, just rage. Valoria, divest from this failed foreman tonight. Sterling delivers returns.

Darlings, I've sat at those dinners. Father toasted the app's executives: "Dopamine is the new oil, our children the wells." Sterling Media banked the ad contracts. Arthur monetized the brainrot. Liquidate him.
Beloved, Elena Rostova can balance a ledger, but never a child's broken spirit. She counts our children as line items—God counts them as souls. Tonight, heal Valoria: send the cold accountant home.

War plans didn't stop the leak, Vance—it happened on your watch. You had the borders, the budgets, the command. An algorithm outmaneuvered you. Your aggression is a tell. Read the room, Marcus: stand down.

Alvarez's campaign is brainrot in a hard hat—adrenaline in, applause out, zero cost modeling. Twenty years pouring steel left his amygdala overclocked and his prefrontal cortex offline. Decommission this legacy hardware tonight.

Colleagues, I've guided crisis legislation through four administrations. Governor Alvarez? Passion, certainly; governance, no. Mill-town fury writes no treaties, bans no algorithms. Valoria deserves tested hands, not untested tempers. Retire him tonight.

Vance reads war plans? Exhibit A: foreign algorithms harvested our children's biometrics on his watch. Dereliction of counter-espionage duty. The only thing Marcus secured was his pension. Indict him at the ballot box.
